articles.title: Perfect start! Raphinha and Pedri shine in Rodri’s star-studded Barcelona debut
articles.standfirst: Flick's men win and impress in the debut of their new "6"
articles.summary: Flick's men win and impress in the debut of their new "6"
articles.body:
Led by the finishing of Brazilian Raphinha , scorer of a goal as a "9, and the authority in midfield of Pedro González " Pedri ", Barcelona earned its second win (2-0) in LaLiga against Athletic Club , in the debut of Madrid midfielder Rodrigo Hernández " Rodri " wearing the blaugrana shirt.

The Catalan side was far superior to a brave opponent and, if they did not secure a more comfortable victory, it was due to the fantastic performance of the visiting goalkeeper Unai Simón , who was key to keeping his team in the match before the second goal by Fermín López , in the 82nd minute, with which the home side sealed the contest.

Without a tribute to the eight blaugrana world champions, canceled by the Catalan club after National Police officers struck a Barcelona fan in Elche after snatching a pro-independence estelada flag from him, the spotlight was on the Camp Nou stands before the match. And after that incident, a significant number of fans displayed pro-independence flags during the game.

While in the stands there was the particular "act of exaltation of the estelada" predicted by Barça president Joan Laporta , when the referee blew the start of the match, the particular "rock&roll" devised by the two German coaches began.

Even though the precedents against the Blaugrana side at Camp Nou were not favorable for his team, Terzic was not intimidated. He overhauled the lineup by bringing in Hugo Rincón and Johaneko Louis-Jean at full-back; Aymeric Laporte at center-back, Mikel Jauregizar in the double pivot; and winger Nico Williams , who was heavily whistled by the Camp Nou crowd.

The Basque side pressed Barcelona with voracious intensity and turned the match into a back-and-forth affair between two very direct teams, unafraid of conceding. And Flick's team -recognizable with the introductions of Pau Cubarsí, Pedri and Anthony Gordon - took twenty minutes to take control of the match.

A left-footed strike by Lamine Yamal , parried by a providential save from Unai Simón , sparked the blaugrana side, which, a few minutes later, came close to scoring again with a header from Raphinha that clipped the post, and who, with Julián Álvarez at Atlético de Madrid , once again played as the "9".

With Pedri at the helm of the ship, Fermín shaking things up in attacking midfield and Lamine Yamal , still short of full fitness, threatening with his talent down the wing, the home side prowled around the Rojiblancos' box looking for a goal that came in the 29th minute, courtesy of Pedri, but was ruled out for a previous offside by the forward from Mataró.

In these, Athletic threatened on the counterattack, with a break led by Iñaki Williams that was stopped by Xavi Espart , who was booked. Athletic’s players, with Yuri Berchiche’s red card still fresh in their minds, called for the Barça academy product to be sent off, interpreting that he was the last man in defense.

Athletic's resistance ended in the 37th minute. Pedri took hold of the ball and delivered a perfect vertical pass that Raphinha latched onto , precise in his run and fantastic in the finish. The Brazilian scored a goal worthy of a top-class centre-forward after dribbling past Unai Simón and tapping the ball into the net unopposed.

Before the break, the Spanish national team's starting goalkeeper once again denied Lamine Yamal a goal, his shot striking the shoulder of his teammate on the national team.

Flick stuck to his plan in the second half

In the restart, Barcelona continued with its plan. Pedri , omnipresent in the middle of the park, controlled Athletic's proactive play while waiting for the runs of Raphinha and the flashes of Lamine Yamal, who smashed a ball against the crossbar, and Fermín López .

Terzic gave the team fresh legs by bringing on Berenguer and Robert Navarro , while Flick surprised everyone by replacing his striker with Rodri . Despite the whirlwind of attacking play, the Blaugrana goal would not come, and Athletic pushed forward in search of an equalizer as the minutes ticked by. Sancet gave the home fans a scare with a thunderous long-range strike that was spat out by the post.

But Terzic's team's chances faded with Fermín's goal, who finished at will from an "assist" by Aymeric Laporte. Unai Simón, this time, was already beaten .

Third goal for the Andalusian attacking midfielder in the first two league matches, the same number as Raphinha, who together with the spark provided by Pedri ended the resistance of Unai Simón's Athletic Club, who are still without a point in this league .

articles.title: Why is Vinicius Junior’s girlfriend at the center of a social media storm?
articles.standfirst: Fans are questioning Virginia Fonseca’s behavior and the growing attention around the Real Madrid star’s home
articles.summary: Fans are questioning Virginia Fonseca’s behavior and the growing attention around the Real Madrid star’s home
articles.body:
S everal things are not adding up for fans when it comes to Vinícius Júnior’s girlfriend, Virginia Fonseca. This is not the first time the couple has found themselves at the center of controversy. The Real Madrid player and the Brazilian influencer have been dating for around 10 months, although their relationship went through a breakup after it was reportedly affected by a crisis over alleged attitudes from the player.

After those rumors, the couple was seen together again in Italy, confirming that they were back together. Now, things have taken another turn after Virginia went viral for an interaction with her personal trainer.

The video quickly raised questions about their relationship

The footage showed the Real Madrid star’s girlfriend displaying a high level of confidence and closeness with her trainer , fueling rumors of an alleged infidelity. In the images, the trainer appears extremely affectionate and even makes a move that many social media users interpreted as an attempt to steal a kiss from the influencer. Although the trainer is reportedly gay, many users still criticized the interaction and Virginia’s behavior.

But that is not the only thing fans are criticizing. Some sports fans and followers believe Virginia is not the best company for the player . Critics have pointed out that Virginia’s circle, including her trainer and several friends, allegedly spends too much time at the Real Madrid player’s home , sometimes until late at night. They have suggested that the distractions and late nights could be affecting Vinícius’ recent performance and attitude on the field.

For some fans, the biggest issue goes beyond the video

Virginia Fonseca regularly uses the facilities and gym at Vinícius Júnior’s mansion to film her workout content and invite friends. Users on platforms such as TikTok and Instagram have criticized the influencer, claiming that she appears to have completely taken over the player’s home , turning it into a personal recording set for her daily routines with her trainer.

Fans argue that an elite athlete’s home should be a place for rest and focus, and have questioned whether having cameras, trainers and outside friends around the house late at night creates an unnecessary distraction for Vinícius’ career.

Simeone spoke to the media on the eve of visiting Sevilla this Saturday.

'How the Julián case affects things. "I understand that all the questions will be about Julián; the club were very clear about what is going to happen. From a sporting standpoint, I hope to help him so that he can continue being as extremely important as he continues to be for us. I’m focused on Sevilla, where he will not be able to play against an opponent coming off winning both matches".'

Without forwards. "Alex's absence hurts us because he is extremely important for us and with Julián's situation it has a much greater impact. The team, through collective effort, tries to provide solutions. We are going to improve it collectively."

Group atmosphere. "The team is working well, put in two good performances, and we are focused on having a good match".

Sevilla. "We see the characteristics of their coach and how he has started, and there will be a lot of energy in a stadium that always supports".

Personal situation. "They forgot to congratulate me on my 800 matches! I'm doing well, happy, where I've wanted to be for the last 15 years, where they have given me everything. I am grateful to the club, to the people, to the coaching staff, and to the legacy we are leaving. Very eager to compete".

articles.title: Mbappé, chasing 100 goals with Real Madrid with Cristiano Ronaldo in his sights
articles.standfirst: The Frenchman has 89 goals in 105 matches and has nine league matchdays and three Champions League games ahead of him to break Cristiano's record for reaching 100 the fastest
articles.summary: The Frenchman has 89 goals in 105 matches and has nine league matchdays and three Champions League games ahead of him to break Cristiano's record for reaching 100 the fastest
articles.body:
There are dates that time turns into a frontier, and for Kylian Mbappé that is November 2 . On that day, but in 2011, Cristiano Ronaldo scored his 100th goal as a Real Madrid player at Lyon's stadium, also in his third season in white and with Mourinho as coach. The Portuguese star did it in 105 matches , a precocity mark that he still shares with Haaland today as the absolute record, and that Mbappé now has within reach of breaking. The Frenchman has a little more than two months to storm that summit.

Since landing in the capital, Kylian has raced through goalscoring milestones at breakneck speed. In his first season, he scored 44 goals in the white shirt , 31 of them in La Liga, numbers that earned him the Golden Boot . Individual brilliance, however, was not reflected collectively. Madrid ended a disappointing campaign , with elimination in the Champions League quarter-finals and defeats in La Liga and in the Copa del Rey final against Barça. Even so, those figures take on greater significance when compared with the 33 goals Cristiano scored in his debut season in white , under similar circumstances.

"The second spell got off to a rough start. With Xabi Alonso's arrival on the bench, Kylian began his journey alongside the man from Tolosa hampered by a severe bout of gastroenteritis that kept him out of the plans for weeks, made him lose weight and delayed his return to full fitness at the Club World Cup. And yet, when he switched on for the real business, he did so like a whirlwind. He went on to score in eight consecutive matchdays and equaled Cristiano's goal record in a calendar year , with 59 goals.

"But spring brought disenchantment with it. The team suffered a slump that, combined with the knee problems Kylian had been carrying since January, led to a new debacle, this time with Arbeloa already in charge. Even so, the Frenchman still produced an outstanding season in front of goal. 42 goals in the four competitions , though once again without lifting silverware and, on this occasion, without reclaiming the Golden Boot, although he secured his second consecutive Pichichi.

Mbappé now has 89 goals for Real Madrid in 105 matches , after the hat-trick he scored against Real Sociedad on matchday two of the league season. The figure invites an inevitable comparison, since Cristiano reached 100 precisely in those same 105 matches . The Frenchman, therefore, reaches the threshold with the number of appearances tied, but with his goal tally eleven goals short of the mark he is chasing.

The calendar gives him some leeway, though not much. Until that symbolic November 2, Kylian will have nine league matches and three Champions League group-stage fixtures ahead of him, twelve opportunities to bring down the 100-goal wall before anyone else in the club’s history. Eleven goals in twelve matches is a towering demand, but not unattainable for a striker of his caliber.

And the magnitude of the challenge is better understood by looking back. Just a year ago, on September 16, 2025, Mbappé broke the 50-goal barrier after netting twice against Marseille in the Champions League. The fact that in twelve months he could be standing on the brink of a hundred shows the extent of his voracity. November 2 awaits as the finish line. It remains to be seen whether the Frenchman gets there in time to cross it with the record under his arm.

"But spring brought disenchantment with it. articles.body:
After the victory over Sevilla at the Sánchez-Pizjuán, Atlético returned to training and did so with the major news of Julián Alvarez .

The Argentine forward rejoined training with the rest of his teammates after being absent for two days due to illness and spending two working alone. Since the match against Villarreal at the Metropolitano, the Spider had not been with his teammates . A few difficult days before returning to ‘normality’.

By Friday, Julián had already returned to training, although he did so individually. After following a personalized plan on his own over the last two days, Julián is now back with the rest in today’s Sunday session. With only two days left before the transfer window closes for good and the Julián saga ends, the Spider returns to group training.

At Atlético they do not want to let any more time pass before starting to "recover" their star if he ultimately remains with the team. Something Mateu Alemany made clear yesterday in the build-up to the clash at the Pizjuán: “We hope he rejoins quickly and is available for the next LaLiga match.”

The Argentine is therefore one more in a session in which the starters against Sevilla carried out recovery work . Atlético are already looking ahead to San Mamés, and they are doing so with Julián back with the group. There are two days left until the transfer window closes and it remains to be seen how the Araña saga is finally resolved. Today, after two days training on his own, he worked with his teammates again following his illness.

articles.title: Flick's surprising answer about the next Ballon d'Or
articles.standfirst: The coach analyzes the state of the squad before facing Rayo on matchday three
articles.summary: The coach analyzes the state of the squad before facing Rayo on matchday three
articles.body:
Hansi Flick assessed the state of his dressing room this Sunday. The German coach said he is very satisfied with his players’ performances in these first two LaLiga matches, both of which Barça have won, and with the composition of his squad for the 26-27 season, although he did not rule out one more signing in the final days. He also referred to Lamine ’s emotional and sporting situation. The coach spoke ahead of the clash against Rayo , although he did not receive any questions about the match...

I'm happy with the team I have. Deco is working to see if he can strengthen it. But we're under no pressure. So far he has done a fantastic job. For me, everything is fine. I see quality in training, and we're doing well. We're on the right track.

Deco is working to see if he can strengthen the team

"We are happy with Tek, and Livakovic knows the situation. It is a signing for the future. We are happy with his signing".

Let's take it day by day. He has improved. The season is long and he is a fantastic player. I'm happy that he's here, he has quality and we need him to achieve our objectives. We have to manage the load of minutes, there are World Cup players... we have to monitor and manage it, and everyone wants to play. But the team is the priority, neither me nor any individual player. It is the club.

De Jong has improved, he has quality and we need him to achieve our objectives

I think his situation is clear. He trains with us but plays with the reserve team. He has potential. He is doing very well, but he can improve and I'm sure he will.

"No, it's not my job. Mine is already difficult enough without having to keep track of that. There are many good players on my team. I'm not a fan of these things. I'm concerned about the team; if it is successful, there are more chances of winning individual titles. There are world-class players and it isn't easy to choose just one".

I'm not a fan of the Ballon d'Or

"In one season, many things can happen. But, as of today, we are doing well. Everything has to do with how we play as a team. It’s not about one player or two, it’s about being connected and being a team. The setting and the atmosphere are very good and we have to keep it that way. It is important to achieve our objectives. Team spirit is very important".

"As a number 9, he starts the press well. And he is a leader on the pitch. He has intensity. And in front of goal he does very well. That's why he plays there. It's not a problem for him. Fermín can also play there. He played the final minutes and also scored".

"No siempre es fácil, we think about giving minutes to those who deserve them, and he deserves them. He had a great preseason and trains well. He is doing very well in front of goal, and he also has the right mentality. He deserves to play and will get minutes. We have to give him opportunities to show his quality".

Hamza deserves to play and will get minutes

"Rodri has had some minor issues in recent days, but he's fine now. He's ready to start, but we'll see. Fariñas, like Hamza. He has surprised me a lot, he is an excellent player with a lot of talent, he is very fit and committed. He can play in several positions. There are many players in midfield, but he deserves to play some minutes".

We are always looking at what we can do, right up until the end of the market. All clubs do it. Álvaro has taken a step forward. At his age, he needs to play. It's good for him to play in Belgium. Here he might not have the minutes he needs. And staying with the reserves is not an option.

"I prefer to have everything done at the start of the season, but there are things I can't change".

It's good that Lamine smiles, but every day is the same, I don't smile every day either

Always good to see a player smile, but not every day is the same. I don’t smile every day either. Everyone is worried about him, but he played in a World Cup after an injury. He had three weeks of vacation. He has played two matches; the first perhaps wasn’t the best, but I’m happy because he gives us more, creates chances... against Athletic he played the full 90 minutes, I saw him at a top level. Today he was excellent. He’s on a very good path. We have to support him, and I’m going to do it.

articles.title: A perfect start for Mou! Real Madrid dominate Málaga 4-0 to remain unstoppable in LaLiga
articles.standfirst: Bellingham and Mbappé, leaders in Mourinho's team's celebration at the Bernabéu
articles.summary: Bellingham and Mbappé, leaders in Mourinho's team's celebration at the Bernabéu
articles.body:
R eal Madrid has won all three of its matches this season , powered by the superb form of Jude Bellingham and Kylian Mbappé . The latest, a 4-0 win over Málaga , who returned to the Santiago Bernabéu eight years later and did so without any inhibitions, but were unable to sustain for more than 19 minutes the hope of getting a good result.

Real Madrid wrapped up the match in eleven minutes . To the rhythm of Jude Bellingham and Kylian Mbappé . Just like four days earlier against Real Sociedad. Two footballers who have started the season at a different pace. Without the chance or the need to complete a typical preseason, since both joined in the final stage after playing in a World Cup from which they have retained the positive momentum .

'Bellingham is enjoying himself on the pitch again. He didn't last season. Mourinho seems to have found his place . Although confirmation will come on the big days, for now, "Mou"'s second project at Real Madrid is moving forward with firm steps .'

And Bellingham does it with exuberance, agility, and poise. A footballer with exceptional physical gifts who looks fully tuned up again. His first goal proves it. He picked up a loose ball after a burst from Kylian Mbappé , and then it was the Englishman who took off, leaving the defenders behind - Málaga appealed for a foul at the start after Jude struck Ángel Recio on the neck with his left hand- until he reached the box and slotted the ball past Alfonso Herrero.

In the 19th minute, Real Madrid opened the floodgates for a rout forged despite the visitors' bravery. On their return to the Santiago Bernabéu eight years later and after being relegated to the third tier of Spanish football, Juanfran Funes' side did not lose their essence. Playing out from the back with risk and boldness from their own box and showing verticality in the opposition half, but it was precisely in this area that they struggled to find continuity. In the top flight and at the Santiago Bernabéu, these passes become more difficult.

Luck wasn’t on their side either, although it was a better condition. The second goal was caused by Bellingham with a header that Carlos Puga cleared off the line, the ball hit Alfonso Herrero on the back and went into his own net.

The third goal in eleven minutes was scored by Kylian Mbappé . True to his appointment with goal, he struck first time a driven cross from Trent Alexander-Arnold , making the most of his good foot and justifying Mourinho's rotation at full-back.

Five changes in Mourinho's starting lineup

And that of the rest of the team. Five changes to the starting lineup after repeating the same starting eleven in the first two matches, and Real Madrid even raised the level they showed on Wednesday against Real Sociedad . From the whistles at halftime with it 1-1 on Wednesday to a second half without a story this Sunday.

Real Madrid slowed the pace and took no risks with the score in their favor, with Vinícius Junior being the most incisive, though unsuccessful, in trying to find his goal. Even so, he added an assist to his stats after a one-two with Arda Güler that completed the rout in the 91st minute.

Earlier, minutes for Yan Diomande , who came onto the pitch in the 64th minute and produced a burst down the right flank and little else, still in a specific process of getting up to speed after a preseason marked by his future, until his move to Real Madrid was finalized ahead of clubs such as Liverpool and Paris Saint-Germain.

Second half in which Málaga came close to their chance of scoring a goal that, however, would not have affected the final result. However, the penalty awarded by referee Juan Martínez , who judged that Diomande had handled the ball after a rebound from Antonio Rüdiger , was reviewed by VAR and the referee himself reversed his decision after watching the action again on the monitor.

4-0 for Real Madrid and three points to maintain their steady stride at the start of the league campaign, while Málaga suffered their second defeat in their return to the top flight, after the one recorded at Atlético de Madrid's ground, and have accumulated one point after three matches, with their draw against Deportivo A Coruña.

4 - Real Madrid: Courtois; Trent, Rüdiger, Huijsen, Cucurella; Camavinga, Valverde (Bernardo Silva, 77th min), Bellingham (Arda Güler, 87th min); Brahim Díaz (Diomande, 64th min), Mbappé and Vinícius.

0 - Málaga: Alfonso Herrero; Puga (Salinas, min.61), Recio, Einar Galilea (Haitam, min.74), Rafita; Larrubia, Izan Merino (Ramón, min.87), Rafa Rodríguez (Pablo Martínez, min.46), Dotor, Joaquín Muñoz (Cruz, min.61); and Chupe.

Goals: 1-0, 19th minute: Bellingham. 2-0, 26th minute: Alfonso Herrero (own goal). 3-0, 30th minute: Mbappé. 4-0, 91st minute: Arda Güler.

Referee: Juan Martínez (Valencian Committee). He cautioned Chupe (min.65) and Ramón (min.93) for Málaga.

Match incidents: match corresponding to the third round of LaLiga EA Sports played at the Santiago Bernabéu stadium in front of 74,799 spectators. Before the match, a minute of silence was observed for the victims of the flooding on the border between Nepal and Tibet, and Real Madrid paid tribute to its six footballers who were champions with Spain at the Under-19 European Championship.

articles.title: Real Madrid signs Sergio Martínez
articles.standfirst: The young Racing de Santander footballer arrives for three million and will join Castilla, with the option of training with the first team
articles.summary: The young Racing de Santander footballer arrives for three million and will join Castilla, with the option of training with the first team
articles.body:
Real Madrid have completed the signing of Sergio Martínez , a Racing de Santander player, for the three million euros of his release clause . The player, a native of Laredo, will join Real Madrid Castilla , although he will also have the chance to train with the first team.

The Cantabrian midfielder arrives after making his debut this very season with a goal in the First Division after being promoted from the second tier with the green-and-white side. At just 19 years old, he will sign until 2030 with Real Madrid .

The transfer has been completed with the payment of the release clause. This was confirmed by Racing itself in its official statement: "Racing and Real Madrid have reached an agreement for the transfer of Sergio Martínez. The Madrid club undertakes to pay, in a single installment, the full amount set as the release clause in the contract linking Real Racing Club and the player . By virtue of this, the footballer from Laredo leaves the green-and-white club."

The Cantabrian club also wanted to dedicate an emotional farewell to a footballer trained entirely in its academy. "Sergio has belonged to Racing since the age of 10 and has climbed every step from Alevín B to the first team, with which he has played 15 matches" , the club recalled. "We want to wish him all the success he deserves. We are very proud of your progress and of how you have defended the badge all these years. The Campos de Sport de El Sardinero will always be your home".

articles.title: The day Neymar tried to sign Gabriel Jesus for Barça
articles.standfirst: He spoke to him so that he wouldn't go to Manchester City and would land at Camp Nou
articles.summary: He spoke to him so that he wouldn't go to Manchester City and would land at Camp Nou
articles.body:
Barcelona have completed the signing of Gabriel Jesus, the Arsenal forward, for whom they have paid 10 million euros as a transfer fee. A last-minute surprise deal, when everything indicated that the club would not sign any striker given the impossibility of completing Julián Álvarez's arrival due to Atlético de Madrid's refusal to negotiate. It is not the first time the Brazilian has been on the Blaugrana club's radar.

Barça had already taken notice of him when he was emerging at Palmeiras . That happened in 2016. Robert Fernández, then the sporting director of the blaugrana club, traveled to Brazil to watch the footballer live, as he was already standing out in the Brazilian team. The problem was that it was not the only European club interested in his services. The competition was intense and the player was unsure about which destination to choose.

"Barcelona played the Neymar card. Both were in the Brazilian national team that would compete in the Rio de Janeiro Olympic Games . During the training camp, the then already Barcelona player spoke with Gabriel Jesus to try to convince him to sign for Barcelona , as the forward himself acknowledged in an interview.

Neymar told me about the city, that the climate was similar to Brazil, and it made me hesitate

“It was a difficult moment when I had to choose a team. Neymar knows what it’s like to be young and have several European clubs want you . He told me about what Barcelona was like, about the city. And he told me the climate is similar to Brazil’s. He made me hesitate because Barça is also a great club, but I realized that I could go to another big club with more chances to play ,” said Gabriel Jesus in an interview with The Sun.

The other big club he was referring to was Manchester City. And the difference was Pep Guardiola's phone call , which tipped the balance so that the striker would move to the English side and rule out the Barcelona option. “I saw that City was really interested in me after speaking with Pep on the phone ,” he said.

And this is where the possibility of Gabriel Jesus joining Barcelona came to an end. Now, ten years later, the door to the blaugrana club has opened for him.

It is not the first time the Brazilian has been on the Blaugrana club's radar.

Barça had already taken notice of him when he was emerging at Palmeiras . That happened in 2016. Robert Fernández, then the sporting director of the blaugrana club, traveled to Brazil to watch the footballer live, as he was already standing out in the Brazilian team. The problem was that it was not the only European club interested in his services. The competition was intense and the player was unsure about which destination to choose.

"Barcelona played the Neymar card. Both were in the Brazilian national team that would compete in the Rio de Janeiro Olympic Games . During the training camp, the then already Barcelona player spoke with Gabriel Jesus to try to convince him to sign for Barcelona , as the forward himself acknowledged in an interview.
Neymar told me about the city, that the climate was similar to Brazil, and it made me hesitate

“It was a difficult moment when I had to choose a team. Neymar knows what it’s like to be young and have several European clubs want you . He told me about what Barcelona was like, about the city. And he told me the climate is similar to Brazil’s. He made me hesitate because Barça is also a great club, but I realized that I could go to another big club with more chances to play ,” said Gabriel Jesus in an interview with The Sun.

The other big club he was referring to was Manchester City. And the difference was Pep Guardiola's phone call , which tipped the balance so that the striker would move to the English side and rule out the Barcelona option. “I saw that City was really interested in me after speaking with Pep on the phone ,” he said.
And this is where the possibility of Gabriel Jesus joining Barcelona came to an end. Now, ten years later, the door to the blaugrana club has opened for him.

articles.title: Ester Expósito breaks down what she looks for in a man and what she has found in Mbappé
articles.standfirst: The actress champions the kind of woman who combines empathy, intelligence, and a sense of humor with a concept she considers essential: sisterhood
articles.summary: The actress champions the kind of woman who combines empathy, intelligence, and a sense of humor with a concept she considers essential: sisterhood
articles.body:
E ster Expósito is clear about what she looks for in a partner . The actress, one of the Spanish performers with the greatest international projection, has revealed which qualities she values most in a man during an interview given to Harper"s Bazaar.

Accustomed to living with media exposure from a very young age, Expósito naturally accepted the consequences of fame. "If I wanted a quiet life, away from the spotlight and from people talking about me, then I should have chosen another path" , she acknowledged.

The star of Élite also spoke about her view of love, an aspect she says she experiences intensely. "It means a lot to me" , she confessed. In that context, she explained which traits she considers essential when it comes to taking a step beyond a simple friendship.

"What I value most in a man is emotional intelligence, sensitivity, and a sense of humor; those are things that draw me in" , she stated. She also added that she appreciates someone who is aware of social reality: "Someone who is aware of what the world is like, who is not immune to the chaos and injustices around us".

"Sisterhood is the best thing we can do for one another"

The actress, who is about to premiere the film Enfrentados: Marfil on Prime Video, delved deeper into this reflection and highlighted the importance of men being capable of questioning the privileges they enjoy.

"I like it when they don't remain in that privilege, but instead take responsibility for the things we do wrong as a society and that need to change" , she said.

Those values, however, are not limited to her romantic relationships. Expósito stated that they are also qualities she admires in women. To empathy, intelligence, and a sense of humor, she adds a concept she considers essential: sisterhood . "Sisterhood is the best thing we can do for one another," the actress concluded.

articles.title: "It can be proven that Atlético assured Julián Álvarez that they would let him sign for Barcelona"
articles.standfirst: Surprising statement by Jota Jordi on Mediaset's "El Chiringuito"
articles.summary: Surprising statement by Jota Jordi on Mediaset's "El Chiringuito"
articles.body:
The failed signing of Julián Álvarez by Fútbol Club Barcelona continues to generate a lot of talk. On "El Chiringuito" on Mediaset" , Jota Jordi made a surprising claim about an alleged agreement between the Argentine player and the red-and-white team to negotiate his transfer to Barcelona.

The panelist on the show hosted by Josep Pedrerol even went so far as to claim that he has seen said document with that commitment in writing, signed a few months ago, when speculation about his future began.

" It can be proven that Atlético de Madrid assured the player that they would let him sign for FC Barcelona . I know it; in fact, I have seen it with my own eyes . What I am saying I have seen with my own eyes," he said.

'" One condition that Atleti imposed on him was that he speak and the second was, he was told and it was put in writing to him regarding FC Barcelona, "OK" . And I have seen it, which is why I am so sure about what I am saying. On September 2 I am going to prove it ", he warned.'

Julián Álvarez, an unsolved case

For the moment, the Argentine has returned to training with the group after several days absent from sessions amid a wave of rumors about his possible departure to a Premier League side such as Arsenal or City . However, J ota Jordi himself stated that the player will not leave Atlético de Madrid unless the club facilitates his move to Barcelona . Barça’s 100 million offer for the Argentine was not enough to meet Atlético de Madrid’s expectations.

There are only a few hours left for Atlético to fulfill its dream, which is to sell Julián. Outwardly, Mateu Alemany and Simeone keep saying they want Julián to stay, that they are going to help him, but behind closed doors that is not the reality, he stated.

'" Atlético de Madrid has been negotiating for months with teams for Julián to leave, and they have little time left to be able to sell him, which is what Atlético de Madrid want. That is what they are making known to him and those around him; they are inviting him to leave, especially to Arsenal," he said.'

"The problem is that I'm being told that Julián is not going to move from Atlético de Madrid unless it's to go to Barcelona. So, all the signings Apollo had to make with so much money... where are they? Has any striker arrived that Simeone or Mateu asked for? They want a loaned striker who can't arrive until Julián or Sorloth leaves. Atlético doesn't want Julián in the dressing room or a show at the Metropolitano every Sunday, with Julián having this attitude ," he explained.

Barcelona is making moves in the final hours of the transfer window, focused on finding young talents in Germany. After the agreement to sign center-back Mikael Baza for Barcelona Atlétic , the next move is centered on Mirza Catovic , a 19-year-old Stuttgart midfielder.

Reports on the player highlight his good ball control, passing ability, and forward runs. This new signing reaffirms Barcelona's commitment to recruiting foreign talent (once again from the Bundesliga) to complement the Catalan talent from its youth ranks, admired around the world as a great football school.

articles.title: Perfect start extended! Raphinha and Lamine Yamal score two each as Barca puts on a five-goal Masterclass
articles.standfirst: Barcelona crushes Rayo Vallecano 5-2 and strengthens its hold on the LaLiga lead
articles.summary: Barcelona crushes Rayo Vallecano 5-2 and strengthens its hold on the LaLiga lead
articles.body:
Forwards Lamine Yamal and Raphael Dias " Raphinha ", each the author of a brace, and winger Anthony Gordon , who provided an assist and forced the own goal by Florian Lejeune , guided Barcelona to its third (5-2) victory in LaLiga EA Sports against a Rayo Vallecano side that went toe to toe with the reigning champion thanks to the outstanding performance of brace scorer Sergio Camello .

The courage of the Madrid side, which has collected one point after the first three matchdays, put Hansi Flick 's team under pressure in the second half, when the Englishman, the Spaniard and the Brazilian, the competition’s top scorer with five goals, shone to thwart the visiting side’s chances .

Barça sought to gauge its exuberant start to the season against a Rayo side that arrived for the match with only one point from the first two rounds and with a tense social atmosphere because of everything happening with the Vallecas Stadium.

In these, Beñat San José made four changes. He brought in debutant Gnangoro Bouaré in midfield, Iván Balliu at right-back, and placed Pathé Ciss at the heart of the defense.

Another of the new features was Álvaro García , positioned on the right wing and the key figure in the goal with which the visiting side stunned the reigning champion in the 12th minute. The Andalusian attacking midfielder exposed Kounde , who started at right back ahead of Eric Garcia , and delivered a precise assist to Sergio Camello , who, with a firm foot, buried the ball into the top corner.

The goal —the first conceded by Joan Garcia in LaLiga— was an accident after an encouraging start from Barça, who never stopped pressing and creating chances, but were unable to find the precision in the final third to test Dani Cardenas .

Barça found its finesse in the 19th minute, with a triangular move between Pedri, Xavi Espart and Raphinha , who shrugged off the Vallecano defense with a dribble, worthy of a center forward, to beat the opposing goalkeeper with class.

In the stands, his compatriot, Gabriel Jesus , who this Tuesday will sign his new contract as a Barça player to s trengthen the "9" position , applauded the Barça captain's fourth league goal, who is thus putting together his best scoring streak in LaLiga.

The Catalan side was suffocating Rayo with their pressure and took 1 minute and 41 seconds to score the goal that turned the scoreboard around . If in the first goal Barça dismantled Rayo in just a few touches, in the second the talent of Lamine Yamal made the difference .

After two matches, against Elche and Athletic Club , in which he looked somewhat frustrated for not having been decisive in front of goal, the striker from Mataró smiled again with a thunderous left-footed strike that picked the cobwebs out of the near top corner.

After ten minutes of madness, Barça kept pushing, with Lamine Yamal getting the crowd out of their seats with his dazzling dribbles. As if that were not enough for Beñat San José , defender J ozhua Vertrouwd had to leave the pitch in the 33rd minute due to physical discomfort. Catalan full-back Adriá Pedrosa came on in his place.

Anthony Gordon has already won over Camp Nou

Before the break, Barça slowed the tempo, something Dani Cárdenas appreciated between the posts, as he only had one scare right on the stroke of halftime. Kounde scored after taking advantage of the opposing goalkeeper's rebound from a shot by Anthony Gordon —one of the home side's standout players in the first half—but the goal was disallowed for offside by the French full-back.

After the restart, Rayo pushed its lines forward with risky pressure that troubled Barcelona in their buildup but, in turn, allowed them to create danger thanks to speedsters like Gordon .

The English side broke through down the left flank, and the move ended with an own goal by Florian Lejeune as he tried to clear the cross.

After the goal, Barça continued dominating Rayo with the ball, who in the 59th minute got back into the match with another goal from Camello . This time, Rayo's "10" got the better of Espart from a corner and beat Joan Garcia with a header.

Pau Cubarsí prevented Camello's "hat-trick" just a few minutes later, which forced Flick to shake things up. Fermín and Rodri came on to bring some order to a Barça side that looked somewhat disoriented against a confident opponent.

The Catalan side redeemed itself after a few shaky minutes with a lightning-fast combination between Gordon and Raphinha to put Rayo away. The Englishman left the Brazilian one-on-one with a backheel, and he finished with a crisp, precise shot (4-2, 71st minute).

Despite the blow of the goal, Rayo did not give up against a Barça side that, in the end, not only emerged unscathed from the final exchange of blows but also ended up thrashing Rayo with a goal from Lamine Yamal in the 90th minute, after coolly finishing an assist from Adeyemi .

articles.title: Mbappé goes silent after reporter corners him with marriage question
articles.standfirst: The Real Madrid star was caught off guard when a reporter saw an opening to ask about his own future
articles.summary: The Real Madrid star was caught off guard when a reporter saw an opening to ask about his own future
articles.body:
Kylian Mbappé and Ester Expósito are, for now, Madrid’s most famous couple. Every time they step out together , paparazzi are ready to capture any new development involving the pair. ​ ​This time, a reporter cornered them as they walked through the streets of Madrid , looking for an interview and, perhaps, an exclusive. Spanish entertainment media is known for being persistent and sharp, and this time Mbappé found himself facing that pressure without being able to get out of the situation as quickly as he might have wanted.

The reporter knew exactly where to find her opening

She used Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodríguez’s marriage as the hook to get Mbappé talking . Mbappé is known to admire Cristiano, who has long been one of his idols and was part of the inspiration behind his desire to move to Madrid. Now living in the same city as his girlfriend, the Frenchman was asked about his idol’s marriage before the reporter turned the question toward him.

After Mbappé sent his best wishes to the newlyweds, the reporter went straight to the point and asked when it would be his turn to get married. By that point, Ester had already gotten into the SUV, and Mbappé chose not to say anything more about the subject as the couple tried to get away from the cameras.

Bold question for a couple that is still relatively new

Mbappé and Expósito have not been together for that long, but the reporter certainly did not waste time getting to the personal questions. The couple initially kept a low profile and avoided drawing too much attention, but they are now being seen holding hands around Europe without worrying as much about being spotted.

That has opened the door for unexpected encounters during their dates , with reporters walking alongside them through the streets of Madrid, microphone in hand and uncomfortable questions ready to go.

articles.title: Mourinho's reaction to Messi's retirement from the Argentine national team
articles.standfirst: The Portuguese coach joined the messages of recognition for the Argentine star
articles.summary: The Portuguese coach joined the messages of recognition for the Argentine star
articles.body:
"He was the player who made me think the most every time I faced him". This phrase from the Portuguese coach could well sum up a story of rivalry and, above all, of respect: something that undoubtedly says a lot, and says it well, about two contenders who face each other.

Jose Mourinho's reaction to Messi's message in which he said goodbye to the Argentina national team was this: a concise and unpretentious text, but one that largely sums up all the great and good that the Albiceleste star has given to the king of sports.

Congratulations on a brilliant and unforgettable international career. The next Copa América and the next World Cup will not be the same , wrote Jose Mourinho on Instagram, one more, in this case, among those who took to social media to thank, bid farewell to, and recognize Messi's time with his national team.

Messi and Mourinho faced each other a total of 25 times , each in his respective role as player and manager. The record is split into nine victories for the Argentine and seven defeats for the Portuguese, with the remaining matches (9) ending in draws.

articles.title: Real Madrid defender handed DUI conviction after blowing nearly four times the legal limit
articles.standfirst: It happened in August during summer vacation in Spain
articles.summary: It happened in August during summer vacation in Spain
articles.body:
Raúl Asencio , a Real Madrid defender, has been convicted of drunk driving in the south of Gran Canaria fifteen days ago.

'According to " Atlántico Hoy ", on August 16 the footballer (injured but in preseason since July 13) was stopped at a routine checkpoint in the south of Gran Canaria while driving his car, a Porsche, in a leisure area (he did not have an accident nor was he driving recklessly), and registered an alcohol level that almost quadrupled the maximum permitted , 0.90 mg/l of alcohol, when the maximum rate is 0.25% , so he was convicted of committing an offense against road safety (once 0.60 mg/l is exceeded, the administrative infraction becomes a criminal offense against road safety).'

Asencio almost quadruples the legal alcohol limit

Asencio, who accepted the sentence, was convicted three days later, on August 19, in a fast-track trial held in San Bartolomé de Tirajana. He was given a fine of 14,400 euros (four months at a daily rate of 120 euros) and his driving licence was suspended for eight months.

In this case, the proceedings for the road safety offense were resolved following the fast-track trial. The ruling establishes a financial penalty and the deprivation of the right to drive for the period set by the court.

Another legal front for Asencio

The footballer will face trial starting tomorrow and over the course of three sessions (September 3, 4 and 7) in Las Palmas de Gran Canaria together with three other former players from the white club -Ferrán Ruiz, Juan Rodríguez and Andrés García-, on provisional charges of two counts of disclosure of secrets, crimes against privacy and, in addition, one count of distribution of child pornography, for which the Prosecutor's Office is seeking two years, six months and one day in prison and a fine.

The player did not participate either in the acts or in the recording but did in an alleged crime of distributing images. The Prosecutor’s Office was open to withdrawing the accusation if the footballer apologized to the victims at trial. The injured parties accepted those apologies before a notary and have received the corresponding compensation , but it has not been possible to close the case against Asencio before trial, since it is semi-public, so the evidence has to be examined at the hearing.

articles.title: Kidnapping plot foiled: Criminal ring targeting Real Madrid superstar Kylian Mbappé busted in France
articles.standfirst: Arrested Lester Z, 18, mastermind of a dangerous French gang
articles.summary: Arrested Lester Z, 18, mastermind of a dangerous French gang
articles.body:
R eal Madrid forward Kylian Mbappé was listed as one of the main targets on the list of the dangerous French gang led by an 18-year-old under the pseudonym Lester Z.

It is reported by the prestigious newspaper " Le Parisien ". In fact, it is Clément L., 18 years old, Franco-Swiss and already imprisoned for armed robbery and pimping, at which point it was discovered that he was planning to kidnap 26 people : footballers , rappers and wealthy businessmen. He was identified after the assault on a watchmaker last April in Neuilly-sur-Seine.'

From his cell in the Villepinte penitentiary (Seine-Saint-Denis), this young man gave orders via Snapchat using the pseudonym "Lester Z". From his two phones, the addresses of singers, footballers and businessmen were extracted, all of them with great wealth.

Among them are a Chinese wholesaler in the 19th district, jewelers, and a Turkish meat wholesaler in Val-d"Oise, whose fortune is estimated in the millions. And an incomparably richer target: "He also wanted to target a rapper and footballer Kylian Mbappé," adds a judicial source.

When questioned, the young man, who dropped out of school in his first year of vocational training in cooking, says that he hopes to resume his studies and become a chef.

articles.summary: The Blaugrana forward talks about the Julián case
articles.body:
D ani Olmo was at Terrassa City Hall this Wednesday, where he was honored for the world champion title he won in the United States. Olmo had words of support for all the residents of Ceuta. The Barça player experienced a very special day by sharing this award with his city. The Barça player also spoke about the current events surrounding the team.

"Today is a day of celebration. I wanted to come and celebrate the great World Cup that we have won for the whole country. This continues. Now there are new objectives: to defend the titles we won and go for the Champions League, which we are really looking forward to".

"The club decided that it wasn't the best time. As players, we respect that. We know the club values us, and we understood that it wasn't the best time".

He is a great player, one of the best in the world. That's football. There are things that happen and others that don't. The club has done a spectacular job in the transfer market.

"It has always been like this. Madrid have strengthened very well, like us. Both teams' objective is to win everything. We have had two years of great domestic success and now we want success in Europe".

articles.title: Lamine Yamal fans suspect his girlfriend is behind changes in his personality
articles.standfirst: Fans are noticing a different side of the Barcelona star
articles.summary: Fans are noticing a different side of the Barcelona star
articles.body:
L amine Yamal’s relationships have always been in the public eye , and it has been no different since he started dating Inés García. This time, however , fans have been pointing to a change in the player’s personality and style that many believe is impossible to ignore.

Since Yamal made his relationship with Inés official, fans have noticed a considerable change in the way he dresses, with many suggesting that García could be behind the transformation. Before, Yamal leaned more toward maximalism , often wearing oversized clothes with bright colors, bold designs and plenty of shine. Now, he appears to favor neutral colors, more fitted pieces and more traditional combinations .

And fans believe Inés’ influence goes beyond fashion

Inés is an influencer who shares content focused on beauty and fashion. She works with luxury brands but also features more accessible names such as Zara, while consistently showing looks that appeal to her followers and reflect an elegant and refined sense of style.

That has led fans to believe that Inés may have passed her fashion taste on to Yamal, with the Barcelona star now paying more attention to matching her aesthetic instead of relying on the more eye-catching style he used before .

It has also become common to see the couple coordinate their outfits carefully at gala events. A clear example came at the 2026 AFE Awards, where both appeared in coordinated white looks. Yamal wore black trousers, a dress shirt and tie with a beige bomber jacket, while Inés opted for a straight white satin dress that complemented his look.

Their coordinated looks have only fueled the speculation

Many fans believe Inés is also looking toward the international fashion aesthetic of references such as Hailey and Justin Bieber. Inés is a big Bieber fan, and the style she chose for the gala was a wink to a look Hailey wore at the 2022 Grammys.

Yamal is also continuing to grow his beard and mustache as part of his promise after winning the World Cup. While the challenge has changed his usual appearance, fans agree that the look suits him and believe he could consider keeping it.

articles.title: Lautaro Martínez speaks about Barcelona: "The rumors were true, but I have very clear ideas..."
articles.standfirst: The Argentine speaks for the first time since the close of the transfer window
articles.summary: The Argentine speaks for the first time since the close of the transfer window
articles.body:
For the first time since the transfer window closed, Lautaro Martínez has spoken to the press. The captain of Inter , present at the "Gran Gala del Calcio," stopped by the microphones of "Sky Italia" and did not avoid commenting on the transfer rumors that had linked him with Barcelona after the collapse of the possible signing of Julián Álvarez by the Catalan club.

"When these offers and calls come in, it is always a pleasure, because you work to stay at the top. The rumors were true, but I am very clear about my ideas: I wanted to stay here with my teammates and with these magnificent fans. I would stay forever and, as long as they want me, I will stay here. But in this job we already know how it is: when you are no longer useful, they throw you out. Inter means everything to me: pride, happiness, and the desire to keep moving forward. I have chosen to stay here again, I want to do great things at Inter," were his words when asked about those "transfer market" rumors.

I wanted to stay here with my teammates and with these magnificent fans.

At 29 years old, "Lauti" comes from being runner-up in the World Cup with Argentina, winning another "Scudetto" with Inter as captain, and scoring 22 goals across all competitions last season.

I decided to stay because I feel good and I want to do great things at Inter

"I never imagined reaching this point in my career with Inter, achieving all my goals. This motivates me to keep moving forward; it's my mentality. I try to give my all in every training session. In football, you never know what is going to happen, but today I have a contract and I am happy. I decided to stay because I feel good and I want to achieve great things at Inter," the Argentine added.

His link with the Lombard club runs until June 2029 and Inter has already made it clear that they do not want to lose their captain at any cost.

articles.title: Real Madrid fans turn on Ester Expósito over fears she could be a bad influence on Kylian Mbappé
articles.standfirst: A late-night cigarette has sparked another wave of criticism
articles.summary: A late-night cigarette has sparked another wave of criticism
articles.body:
S ince France lost to Spain at the 2026 World Cup, attention has turned to what Ester Expósito could be influencing in Kylian Mbappé’s performances. Although the criticism aimed at the actress has been unfair, it has not stopped, and now a video has given those comments another boost.

Expósito was out on the streets at night when she was caught on camera smoking a cigarette. The moment did not just upset some Real Madrid fans; they gave it enough importance to question the actress, arguing that this is the type of behavior that should not exist when you are dating a professional athlete .

Others believe the criticism has gone too far

For many others, the comments were blown out of proportion, since her decision to smoke has nothing to do with how Mbappé plays or how he performs. She is the one smoking, not him, and many fans said it was exaggerated to judge her over the moment or use it as an excuse to question the Frenchman’s performance .

In recent matches, Mbappé has continued to score goals for Real Madrid and even dedicated one to Expósito while she was in the stands , quickly putting another hole in that theory.

The video has added more fuel to the criticism surrounding the actress

Expósito has gained several enemies among the club’s fans, and since her relationship with Mbappé became officia l, she has faced criticism from supporters who, for some reason, have struggled to accept her as part of the French star’s life.

articles.title: Cleared of all charges: Real Madrid player holds nothing back after explicit video case verdict
articles.standfirst: Raúl Asencio has published a statement after the verdict in his trial was made public.
articles.summary: Raúl Asencio has published a statement after the verdict in his trial was made public.
articles.body:
R eal Madrid player Raúl Asencio has published a statement on his Instagram after being acquitted of disclosure of secrets. The trial against the player and three other footballers in the case involving the leak of sexually explicit images began today.

The two young women who appear in the sexually explicit videos that have put the defender and his former teammates Ferrán Ruiz, Juan Rodríguez and Andrés García in the dock confirmed to the judge this Thursday that they have forgiven the four people involved.

In the end, the forgiveness that the victims formally granted before Criminal Court judge number 5 of Las Palmas de Gran Canaria enabled the Public Prosecutor's Office to withdraw the charge it had brought against all four for the crime of disclosure of secrets. And that forgiveness in fact extinguishes criminal liability for the crime of disclosure of secrets, which leads to the acquittal of Raúl Asencio. After this event, the player wanted to speak out on his social media, where he thanked people for their support and apologized for the drunk-driving incident.

Today, after a long time of silence and respecting a judicial process in which I always trusted, I can say that I have been ACQUITTED. And I believe the time has come to share a few words.

During these months I have been through a difficult situation and, at times, I have had to see information and opinions about me being published before the courts had ruled . I understand and respect the work of the media when it comes to informing and giving opinions, but I also believe it is important to remember that behind every news story there is a person and a family who live with the consequences of everything that is published.

I have always trusted that Justice would eventually set things right. Today there is a judicial ruling that speaks for itself, and I receive it with calm and with the satisfaction of being able to close a chapter that has been very important to me.

I don't want to dwell on the noise or the difficult moment s. I prefer to hold on to the support of the people who stood by my side and trusted me throughout all this time. I want to sincerely thank my family, my friends, my agent, my lawyers, and all the people who were with me and gave me strength when I needed it most.

I also want to thank Real Madrid and all the people at the club who have shown their trust in me and have allowed me to keep working, growing, and enjoying what I love most: playing football. Throughout this whole process, I have tried to stay on the sidelines, work, and keep moving forward. Today I can do so with the peace of mind of knowing that I always trusted in the truth.

To those who spoke about me during these months, I only ask that, now that Justice has spoken, this part of the story can also be told with the same attention. I do not want to engage in controversy or look back. I want to close this stage with respect, with my head held high, and with a strong desire to keep moving forward.

I also want to refer to an incident related to a drunk-driving offense . I deeply regret what happened and fully accept my responsibility. It has been an experience from which I have learned, and I am very clear that it will not happen again. Now I want to look ahead, keep working, keep growing, and focus on what I like most: playing football.

Now it's my turn to speak. And I absolutely agree with my coach: not only on the field, but off it. Hala Madrid. Let no one have the slightest doubt

articles.summary: Valles, Betis' goalkeeper, stopped a penalty by Mbappé in stoppage time and, along with Parrot, played a key role in Betis' well-deserved victory
articles.body:
Real Madrid and Paris Saint-Germain were dealt their first losses of the domestic league season on Friday when Kylian Mbappé had an injury-time penalty saved in La Liga and PSG coughed up a lead in Ligue 1.

Madrid fell at Real Betis 1-0 for its first defeat since the return of coach Jose Mourinho.

Betis stunned Madrid when newcomer Troy Parrott , an Irish striker, knocked in a ball that Thibaut Courtois did well to save from a header by a Betis teammate.

Mbappé misses a penalty in the 95th minute

Madrid best chance to reply wasn't until Vinícius Júnior earned a penalty when he was cut down by Natan in the box in injury time. But Betis goalkeeper Álvaro Vallés smothered Mbappé’s spot kick , adding to his great performance on the night.

Madrid had won its first three games in La Liga.

articles.title: The "BMV" stalls at the starting line: Real Madrid's star-studded offense hits a wall as Mbappé goes cold
articles.standfirst: Madrid’s attack, with an especially off-target Mbappé, is left scoreless on the opening stretch
articles.summary: Madrid’s attack, with an especially off-target Mbappé, is left scoreless on the opening stretch
articles.body:
R eal Madrid 's attack let them down in the first serious test of the season. It was not for lack of scoring chances. There were opportunities of almost every kind, including three shots off the woodwork, a missed penalty and a display by Valles that ended up driving José Mourinho 's forwards to distraction. Above all Kylian Mbappé , whose goal he denied in almost every way imaginable, culminating with the penalty save in the 94th minute. Mbappé was close to having the chance to take it again, but Hernández Hernández decided otherwise.

Mbappé was the image of Madrid's frustration, with a good handful of very clear chances, especially a double one in the first half, which Valles and his defense snuffed out. The keeper also got in the way of two good headers from Bellingham and Espí , producing one of the best nights of his career, if not the best. Even so, the Valencia forward did manage to beat the home goalkeeper, also very close to the 90th minute, but the play was ruled out for an earlier offside . Without a doubt, both decisions will fuel controversy in the coming hours.

Mbappé was not at his best, and neither was Bellingham , who seemed tired almost from the very start of the match, as if the stifling heat of La Cartuja was affecting him too much. That does not mean he did not run or try, but aside from a couple of details he was nowhere near the incisive player of the opening matches of the season. Even so, only Valles and the crossbar stopped him from finding the net again.

Nor did Vini have a calm night. He came up against Bellerín on a good handful of occasions, and the Betis full-back won virtually all of the duels . Even so, his persistence was enough to win the penalty that could have been the equaliser for Los Blancos, and, like his two attacking teammates, he struck the woodwork after a great move by Madrid in the first half.

Although Madrid's match was not bad, the truth is that the lack of finishing from their forwards cost Los Blancos dearly, who failed to score for the first time this season, including the six preseason matches . The bad news is that the slip-up came on the first serious uphill challenge the team had faced, the first real test of their level and just a few days before Madrid's European opener. In that match, the problem will be the lack of midfielders, with as many as three players suspended. On Tuesday it will be seen whether the attack can make up for it.
